hero.title: Astro Master Template
hero.subtitle: Production-ready template with multi-framework Islands Architecture, Content Collections, i18n, and Tailwind design system.

islands.title: Islands Architecture
islands.description: Ship zero JavaScript by default. Interactive islands hydrate independently for maximum performance.

multiFramework.title: Multi-Framework
multiFramework.description: Use React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Preact side by side in the same project.

contentCollections.title: Content Collections
contentCollections.description: Type-safe Markdown content with Zod schemas for blogs, documentation, and more.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Built-in multi-language support with JSON-based translations and dynamic locale switching.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.description: Tailwind CSS design tokens with dark mode, responsive typography, and reusable UI components.

dx.title: Developer Experience
dx.description: ESLint, Prettier, Husky, Conventional Commits, and CI/CD workflows out of the box.
